queries.natural_language_query: Among players with a known position, what is the average age at each position?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t11"."position", AVG("t11"."age") AS "avg_age"
FROM "player" AS "t11"
WHERE ("t11"."position_id" IS NOT NULL AND "t11"."position" IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY "t11"."position"

queries.natural_language_query: How many players are there for each nationality?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t11"."nationality", COUNT(*) AS "count_all"
FROM "player" AS "t11"
GROUP BY "t11"."nationality"

queries.natural_language_query: For each current NBA team, what is the average number of NBA championships won by its listed players?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t16"."name", AVG("t11"."championships") AS "avg_championships"
FROM "team" AS "t16"
JOIN "player" AS "t11" ON "t11"."team_name" = "t16"."current_nba_team_name"
GROUP BY "t16"."name"

queries.natural_language_query: Among colleges with more than one player in the league, what is the highest number of MVP awards won by any of its players?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t1"."college", MAX("t4"."awards") AS "max_mvp_award_awards"
FROM "college" AS "t1"
JOIN "player" AS "t11" ON "t1"."college" = "t11"."college_id"
JOIN "league" AS "t3" ON "t3"."name" = "t11"."college_id"
JOIN "mvp_award" AS "t4" ON "t4"."player_id" = "t11"."id"
GROUP BY "t1"."college"
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

queries.natural_language_query: Among players with a known position, what is the total number of MVP awards won at each position?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t11"."position", SUM("t4"."none") AS "sum_mvp_award_none"
FROM "player" AS "t11"
JOIN "mvp_award" AS "t4" ON "t11"."position" = "t4"."player_id"
WHERE "t11"."position" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY "t11"."position"

queries.natural_language_query: Among players with at least one NBA championship, what is the most championships won by any player of each nationality?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t11"."nationality", MAX("t11"."championships") AS "max_championships"
FROM "player" AS "t11"
WHERE "t11"."championships" >= 1
GROUP BY "t11"."nationality"

queries.natural_language_query: How many players were drafted in each year after 2010?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t2"."draft_year", COUNT(*) AS "count_all"
FROM "draft" AS "t2"
WHERE "t2"."draft_year" > 2010
GROUP BY "t2"."draft_year"

queries.natural_language_query: For each current NBA team, what is the earliest (lowest) draft pick among its drafted players?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t16"."team_id", MIN("t11"."draft_pick") AS "min_draft_pick"
FROM "team" AS "t16"
JOIN "player" AS "t11" ON "t11"."team_name" = "t16"."current_nba_team_name"
GROUP BY "t16"."team_id"

queries.natural_language_query: Among players with a known position and at least one Olympic gold medal, what is the average number of Olympic golds at each position?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t11"."position", AVG("t11"."olympic_medal.gold_count") AS "avg_olympic_medal.gold_count"
FROM "player" AS "t11"
WHERE "t11"."position" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY "t11"."position"

queries.natural_language_query: For each college, how many of its players have won at least one NBA championship?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t1"."college", COUNT(*) AS "count_all"
FROM "college" AS "t1"
JOIN "player" AS "t11" ON "t1"."college" = "t11"."college_id"
WHERE "t11"."nba_championships_won" >= 1
GROUP BY "t1"."college"

queries.natural_language_query: Among players with at least one FIBA World Cup title, what is the total number of FIBA titles for each current NBA team?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t16"."current_nba_team_name", SUM("t11"."fiba_title_count") AS "sum_player_fiba_title_count"
FROM "team" AS "t16"
JOIN "player" AS "t11" ON "t11"."team_name" = "t16"."current_nba_team_name"
WHERE ("t11"."fiba_title_count" > 0 AND "t11"."current_nba_team" IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY "t16"."current_nba_team_name"

queries.natural_language_query: How many players aged 20 to 40 are there for each nationality?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t11"."nationality", COUNT(*) AS "count_all"
FROM "player" AS "t11"
WHERE ("t11"."age" >= 20 AND "t11"."age" <= 40)
GROUP BY "t11"."nationality"

queries.natural_language_query: For each city that hosts an NBA team, what is the most championships won by any team there?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."name", MAX("t16"."championships_won") AS "max_nba_team_championships_won"
FROM "city" AS "t0"
JOIN "team" AS "t16" ON "t0"."name" = "t16"."name"
GROUP BY "t0"."name"

queries.natural_language_query: How many teams founded before 1970 are based in each city?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."name", COUNT(*) AS "count_all"
FROM "city" AS "t0"
JOIN "team" AS "t16" ON "t16"."name" = "t0"."name"
WHERE "t16"."based_city" < 1970
GROUP BY "t0"."name"

queries.natural_language_query: How many championships has each owner’s team(s) won in total?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t9"."name", SUM("t16"."championships_won") AS "sum_team_championships_won"
FROM "owner" AS "t9"
JOIN "team" AS "t16" ON "t9"."name" = "t16"."owner_name"
GROUP BY "t9"."name"

queries.natural_language_query: Among teams with at least one championship, what is the average number of championships for teams in each city?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."name", AVG("t16"."championships") AS "avg_team_championships"
FROM "city" AS "t0"
JOIN "team" AS "t16" ON "t16"."name" = "t0"."name"
WHERE "t16"."championships" >= 1
GROUP BY "t0"."name"

queries.natural_language_query: What is the average owner age for each nationality?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t9"."nationality", AVG("t9"."age") AS "avg_age"
FROM "owner" AS "t9"
GROUP BY "t9"."nationality"

queries.natural_language_query: Among owners who acquired their team in 2000 or later, what is the earliest acquisition year for each nationality?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t9"."nationality", MIN("t16"."nationality") AS "min_team_nationality"
FROM "owner" AS "t9"
JOIN "team" AS "t16" ON "t9"."team_id" = "t16"."id"
WHERE "t9"."acquisition_year" >= 2000
GROUP BY "t9"."nationality"

queries.natural_language_query: What is the average city population for each state?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t0"."state", AVG("t0"."population") AS "avg_population"
FROM "city" AS "t0"
GROUP BY "t0"."state"

queries.natural_language_query: Among cities with more than one million people, what is the highest GDP in each state?
queries.sql:
SELECT "t15"."state", MAX("t0"."gdp") AS "max_city_gdp"
FROM "state" AS "t15"
JOIN "city" AS "t0" ON "t0"."state_id" = "t15"."id"
WHERE "t0"."population" > 1000000
GROUP BY "t15"."state"
